text.tspan: SMRITI remembers where everyday things were

g.text: Some days, a familiar room can feel a little less familiar.

text.tspan: SMRITI keeps a gentle memory of where everyday things were,
so the answer is close when someone needs it.

g.text: Nothing to learn. Nothing to remember about technology. Just a clear answer.

text.tspan: The glasses have a usual place.
The spatial reality of the room changed.

g.text: Move through the afternoon. See what stayed — and what moved.
The glasses begin on the side table.
The spatial memory engine behind SMRITI.

text.tspan: PHANTOM remembers where things were, compares
that memory with what exists now, and reveals what changed.
A quiet wireframe coordinate baseline is maintained.
Every fixture is mapped into persistent memory.

g.text: SMRITI compares moments so the change doesn't have to live only in your memory.
Moved from side table to bookshelf
SMRITI turns a change in your home into a simple record you can understand.

text.tspan: SMRITI is designed to support caregivers with a clearer picture
without turning everyday life into invasive surveillance.

g.text: Remember the environment, not just the object.
Show what changed instead of forcing someone to remember.
Technology assists the caregiver. It does not replace them.

text.tspan: SMRITI gives caregivers a clearer picture of what changed
— so everyday uncertainty becomes easier to navigate.

g.text: A spatial memory system for everyday life.
